What do we offer? - An attractive gross hourly wage of €16,54; - Shift allowances of 12%, 12%, and 27%; - Travel allowance of €0.40 per kilometer; - Year-end bonus of 4.5%; - 25 vacation days and 76 ADV hours; - Excellent secondary employment conditions, including a pension plan and bicycle plan; - A varied position with room to learn and grow; - Working in an open, informal, and collegial work atmosphere; - Regular fun team outings. 
What will you do? 
As a process operator, you will work in a permanent team of three colleagues and together 
you will ensure a smooth production process. Your tasks will include:Taking in raw materials; - Filling the finished product; - Switching machines on and off; - Performing light administrative tasks; - Ensuring the cleaning and maintenance of the working environment, production machines and tools. 
What will you bring? - An eager to learn and motivated attitude; - Good command of Dutch or English; - You contribute ideas, show initiative, and take responsibility; - You enjoy working with colleagues; - You adhere to food safety and hygiene guidelines.
